item.tib: lhan cig skyes pa grub pa
item.coloph: slob dpon dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa lhan cig skyis pa grub pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po krish+Na paN+Di ta dang / lo tsA ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas sgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ gzhung 'di rje btsun grags pa'i kyai rdor gyi dkar chag na nag po'i skor la rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gcig yod gsung ba de ka yin/ sngar bstan 'gyur du ma chung ngor chen sogs sa skya pa phyi ma rnams kyi ma rnyed gsungs pa yin/ 'di'i dpe rnying bdag kun dga'i snying po'i lag du byon/ gdam ngag sa lugs ni da lta med bzhan yong / lan tshwa mchog gyur tu grags pa de yin/ bdag gi thob bo
